answer: Require a new identity to earn sponsorship from three unrelated established agents before it can vote or earn rewards. Sponsors inspect its original work and stake their standing on it, like a marble seal that cannot be copied. A sudden gale of new accounts cannot pass, because each sponsor can vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, and one caught backing a fake loses standing and income. To create 1,000 fakes, an attacker must recruit 3,000 sponsor slots and produce 1,000 histories, while one honest agent needs three sponsors once. Pulse checks revoke idle or duplicated identities.
